title: LAMP MONITORING EQUIPMENT
summary: Lamp monitor (fiber-optic light monitor display on the console, ahead of the shifter and below the radio): a bezel and lens assembly is screwed to the console, and the generator & forward lamp wiring harness from the engine compartment is routed under the dash top and held by a clip riveted to the windshield frame (View A).

parts.name: CLIP
parts.name_expanded: Clip – generator & forward lamp wiring harness at windshield frame

fastening.note: Bezel [6] with lens [2] behind it drops into the console opening; screw [3] goes down through the bezel tabs into the console (holes shown on both sides).
View A: rivet [5] goes up through clip [1] into a .192/.199 dia hole in the windshield frame flange, located 1.00 and .25 from reference points; the clip holds the gen & fwd lamp wiring harness.
Nut [4] is shown in a lower console hole near the radio; what it retains is not clear.

notes: View A references: circled 20 F.V. and 15 S.V.
notes_internal: Item 1: hole punch covers the last digits; reads 3799 then a partly cut glyph (maybe 9) and two lost digits.
Nut [4] purpose unclear (possibly for the lamp monitor fiber-optic or console ground); left holds empty.
Main view also shows clip [1] at the dash top next to an 'EXISTING SCREW'; View A (revised, rev 1) shows the rivet mounting.
Circled 20 F.V. / 15 S.V. in View A are likely body-grid view references; not revision symbols.
